title: Runtime fabric weekly handoff - Ramon scratchpad
content:
Purpose: prep notes + quick agenda for the weekly runtime/infra/console triage. Mostly a lightweight handoff doc I can read before the 9:30 sync. Keep it short, surface blockers, and leave clear action-items.

Attendees (tentative): Ramon (owner), Maya (infra), Ivy (console), Zoe (sre), Tom (dedicated), optional: Arjun (observability)

Quick status (1-2 bullets each):
- Serving runtime: stable p99 tail but notice small spike on 3/8 during long-seq evals (KV cache hit drop ~6%). Investigating cache TTL coupling.
- Infra: autoscale burst issues on eu-west-1; cold-start latency occasional 2-3s. Possible instance type mismatch for burst group.
- Console: some tracing links 404 for older traces; UI missing model-variant selector on rollout page.

Agenda (30m total):
1) 5m - Quick wins / shoutouts
2) 10m - KV cache evictions & sequence distribution (Maya + Ramon) - what changed in load pattern, telemetry to add
3) 8m - Autoscale flapping reproducer + short-term mitigations (Tom)
4) 5m - Console rollout selector bug + tracing link fix (Ivy)
5) 2m - Parking lot / next steps

Notes to self / prep items:
- Bring recent flamegraphs from 3/8 spike (attach link in Slack).
- Prepare sample requests that trigger the KV miss pattern (will paste to #runtime).
- Check the autoscaler logs for the burst group 03/08 02:00-03:00 UTC (need INFRA-1021 logs).

Open questions / hypotheses:
- Hypothesis A: long-seq evals bypass prefix caching because prompt shapes differ; need to verify cache keying behavior.
- Hypothesis B: autoscale policy threshold too tight for ephemeral evaluation bursts; consider short warm-up buffer.

Action items (current sprint):
- Action: add finer-grained metrics for KV cache hit by prefix-length - Owner: Ramon - Due: 2026-03-15 - Status: todo
- Action: start temporary warm-up pool for eu-west-1 burst group (config change) - Owner: Tom - Due: 2026-03-13 - Status: in_progress
- Action: console: add guard for missing trace links and fallback URL - Owner: Ivy - Due: 2026-03-14 - Status: todo
- Action: run replay of 3/8 traffic in staging to reproduce p99 spike - Owner: Maya + SRE - Due: 2026-03-16 - Status: todo

Follow-ups from last week (brief):
- Quantization rollout A/B test (PR 612) paused due to slightly higher perplexity on eval set - need follow-up with evals team (see linked PR).
- Canaries for dedicated autoscale were deployed; metrics looked OK except during burst window. Logged INFRA-1021.

Parking lot / low priority items:
- Explore smarter prefix normalization for caching (longer-term).
- Document warm-start heuristics for Dedicated GPU pools.

Personal notes (scratch):
- Remember to ping Arjun about adding a trace tag for "eval-run" so we can filter dashboards.
- Quick feedback: keep next week's meeting to 25m if no critical items.
- Draft a short blurb for Friday all-hands if we stabilize p99 by EOD Thu.

End of scratchpad. Will convert to crisp agenda and post to #runtime two hours before meeting.
